method: Visual self-assessment against the sole uploaded image, supplemented by independent agent review. Scores are subjective and are not a certification of AAA production quality.
scope: Recorded assessments whose numeric results remain available. No missing historical scores have been invented.

assessments.decision: baseline at that time
assessments.notes: Reference skin and revised face optics helped; hair coverage, roots, long clumps, and tailoring still limited realism.

assessments.decision: accepted
assessments.notes: Fuller card groom, finer fringe, cheek strap removed, brighter cotton and shoulder counterpose. Crown seams and regular long hair bundles remain visible.

assessments.decision: accepted
assessments.notes: Neck colors from the same uploaded reference improve continuity with the face. Keep facial proportions stable while correcting hair. Upper neck rim was subsequently tucked inside jaw geometry.

assessments.decision: rejected experimental fiber-only groom
assessments.notes: Twelve thousand subpixel tubes produce sparse, noisy coverage, bald crown gaps and two uniform long bundles. Three million triangles did not improve visual quality. Default remains the accepted card groom.

assessments.decision: rejected experimental groom
assessments.notes: Continuous coverage solves sparse tubes, but exposes a scalp patch, narrow paired long bundles and abrupt crown/back boundaries.

assessments.decision: accepted
assessments.notes: Cleaner collar/placket, rounder closed ear shell, corrected neck rim, balanced lights and restrained corneal reflection. Hair still limits overall realism.

assessments.decision: accepted
assessments.notes: Removed photographic hair contamination from temple colors, preserving the source eye and mouth anchors. Ear tessellation reduced while preserving silhouette; anatomy budget passes.

assessments.decision: not adopted; further corrections pending
assessments.notes: New crown flow and layered locks still have a nape transition kink and early shoulder flare. Found shared palette mutation turning fine fringe black; correction requested.

assessments.decision: accepted working baseline
assessments.notes: Denser hair body and depth ordering remove white shirt gaps. Shortened nape core removes central back hem. Broad opaque locks and shoulder cutout still limit realism; independent review keeps 67.

assessments.decision: not adopted; crown frame correction pending
assessments.notes: Corrected palette mutation and continuous nape improve experimental groom. Crown comb ridges, raised roots, broad flat temple flaps and uniformly fanned tips remain. Skin illumination compensation at 0.35 adopted after independent comparison, without a score increase.

assessments.decision: accepted restrained color and material calibration on existing groom
assessments.notes: Controlled comparison shows large inter-lock color differences cause painted stripes. Compressed those differences and selected moderate anisotropy. Strong white reflections expose broad card geometry and were not adopted on the old groom.

assessments.decision: accepted continuous collar support and shared eye tangent correction
assessments.notes: Removed the hard collar support discontinuity and aligned upper facing. Eye surfaces share a small depth correction reducing outward center tilt, without moving the aperture corners. Front and profile renders remain coherent; anatomy checks pass.

assessments.decision: accepted new groom as default
assessments.notes: Correct ellipsoid frames, softer ash chestnut surface, varied waves and improved shoulder contact now outweigh the previous groom. Remaining defects include large lower gaps, opaque temple flaps, gray fringe and crown patch boundaries. Independent overall score 70.

assessments.decision: retained accepted corneal material after diagnostic comparison
assessments.notes: Compared baseline, no environment reflection, hidden cornea and reduced refraction in front and oblique views. Material-only changes offer little convincing improvement; physical corneal baseline retained. No score increase.

assessments.decision: accepted fuller groom
assessments.notes: 104 inner curved locks substantially close large lower gaps; darker fringe better matches the source. Regular pointed back ends, hard crown patches and bright temple chips remain. Native WebGPU, finite geometry and idle demand rendering verified.

assessments.decision: accepted targeted skin atlas cleanup; further jaw correction pending
assessments.notes: Feathered source jaw guard removes the black jaw chip. Averaged clean source patches reduce lateral bands, and a rear atlas improves albedo continuity. A diagonal brown lower-jaw mark remains and is being corrected. No feature coordinates changed.

assessments.decision: retained baseline ear material after comparison
assessments.notes: Stronger procedural concha and canal color variations produce little visible depth improvement. They were not adopted. Geometry occlusion and ear surface relief require investigation.

assessments.decision: rejected shared crown alpha cutoff
assessments.notes: Staggered rear ends improve but the common root alpha cutoff exposes a horizontal band around the crown. Ear wisps extend too far. Restored the accepted35 groom for the isolated cloth comparison.

assessments.decision: accepted bounded cloth relief and beveled buttons
assessments.notes: Button pulls and lower placket crease read in close view, without changing collar or neck coordinates or adding draw calls. Five-view render shows no new hair/cloth intersections.

assessments.decision: accepted narrower jaw guard; local tone corrections pending
assessments.notes: The long brown jaw edge is reduced while protected feature samples remain stable. A smaller cheek triangle and central chin patch persist in unlit atlas diagnosis and are being traced to exact source samples.

assessments.decision: accepted improved crown-to-length transition
assessments.notes: The horizontal ring is removed and crown ridges reduced. Independent overall72. Large lock roots still produce localized crown patches and folded temple chips; individual raycast triangles identify the affected front guides. Graphic fringe and pointed back ends remain.

assessments.decision: retained softer portrait lighting after cloth comparison
assessments.notes: Compared baseline cotton, removal of previous cloth color boost, and stronger lateral key light. Stronger light shows cloth relief but changes neck/face tone; no global lighting or cloth color change adopted.

assessments.decision: accepted ear anatomy and localized skin tone repairs
assessments.notes: Integrated source candidates41 and43. Closed ear shell retains outline and triangle budget; right head seat clears buried cartilage. Geometry tests pass and five-view inspection shows no regression. Confirmed cheek/chin source-shadow patches are locally neutralized while protected features and fine source detail remain.

assessments.decision: accepted guide-curve repair with antialiasing48
assessments.notes: Monotonic crown-to-ear joins remove both bright temple chips. Five-view review confirms improved transitions. Remaining far-ear exposure and side-lock bulges are assigned to the next groom, along with graphic fringe, transverse crown patches and regular back ends.

assessments.decision: 6 percent lower-face candidate selected; acceptance waits for neck repair
assessments.notes: Compared0,4,6,8 percent shortening below fixed eye level with attached UV colors. Independent reviewer prefers6 percent. Small neck edge becomes exposed, so this runtime-only deformation is not yet accepted as default. Full portrait and profile recheck pending.

assessments.decision: accepted selectable linear-light supersampling after complete viewer verification
assessments.notes: Twofold internal sampling preserves exact900x1200canvas andPNG dimensions. Fixed the WebGPU render-target UV orientation; WebGPU and explicit WebGL render upright. Native sampling releases the larger target. Browser checks pass for five views, idle0frames, turntable, mobile overflow, PNG download, and explicit fallback gate. GLB normal-map compatibility repaired with export-only texture copies; valid67,392,932byteGLB produced.

assessments.decision: accepted bounded outer-socket and nasal-wall tone correction
assessments.notes: At most14sRGB/channel on stretched outer-right socket and7 on nose sidewall. Protected eyelid/aperture masks remain untouched. Full portrait, detail and unlit atlas retain source features; visual effect is subtle and does not alone warrant a higher score.

assessments.decision: accepted lower-face compaction with fitted upper neck
assessments.notes: Six percent compaction holds in full portrait and both profiles. Upper neck follows the same posed head-space warp, closing the previously exposed junction. Native head minimumJacobian0.89875, neck0.94; neckmaximumWorldDisplacement0.066204,2592lowerverticesunchanged. FacialUVs preserved. Next likeness comparison is head placement over the blouseV; hair remains the principal quality limit.

assessments.decision: accepted head placement and fitted neck
assessments.notes: Compared additional world-X shifts of 0, .20, .26, and .32. Selected .26 to align the head with the blouse V. Upper neck blends into that shift while the lower attachment stays fixed; minimum Jacobian .978077. Front, both profiles, and back reviewed. GLB exporter separately round-tripped the actual scene without changing live geometry, pixels, or texture-source versions.

assessments.decision: rejected fringe shading regression; accepted checkpoint remained 50
assessments.notes: Round fringe cores produced bright white streaks. Crown and mass map brightness also caused broad patch bands. Five native views inspected; material isolation followed.

assessments.decision: selected matte fringe and near-white map controls for integration
assessments.notes: Compared baseline, softer specular, matte, diffuse, hidden fine detail, and white map RGB with original alpha. Matte and diffuse eliminated white fringe streaks; whitening only map RGB removed broad map-related crown bands. These were diagnostic runtime controls.

assessments.decision: accepted blouse component; overall hair regression awaited repair
assessments.notes: Matched three central body buttons and one facing button to the sole reference. Revised placket curve, button spacing, and supporting folds; inspected full front and isolated garment. Collar, neck, and seam clearances retained.

assessments.decision: accepted combined pose, blouse, and hair material checkpoint
assessments.notes: Native front, detail, both profiles, and back reviewed. Matte 1305-strand fringe removes white glints; near-white albedo flow map preserves original alpha and reduces broad crown patches. Ring seam normals welded. Reference resemblance estimated 76 and multiview finish 70; subjective overall 75. Remaining priorities: cap-like crown, regular rear sawtooth hem and gaps, separated neck-height locks, facial silhouette, and cloth realism.

assessments.decision: accepted 2.5 percent guarded lower-cheek taper
assessments.notes: Compared fresh native WebGPU front, detail, and quarter views at 0, 2.5, and 4 percent. Selected 2.5 percent: slightly closer soft lower-face contour; 4 percent begins to pinch. Continuous-face X alone changes before skin compensation; eye, lip, ear, UV, head-space Y and Z preserved. Actual minimum Jacobian .874585, 24156 changed vertices, maximum displacement .016347. No new ear gap visible. Small refinement does not alone raise the overall score.

assessments.decision: accepted broader cloth folds and closed placket edge
assessments.notes: Native front, isolated garment, and both profiles reviewed. Broader unequal button rolls, continuous placket trough, hanging fold, and shoulder compression improve drape. Closed placket thickness .0045, 1816 extra triangles, no extra draw calls. Neck, upper opening, collar, facing, crop, placket XY, and 3+1 button layout fixed. No new visible hair collision. Cloth remains too smooth for the requested production standard.

assessments.decision: retained existing socket cap after comparison
assessments.notes: Compared maximum outer-socket lifts14,20,26 with the same aperture/lid guards, nose cap7 and geometry. Larger cap alone gives little useful improvement; the production atlas retains14. No higher score or default change from this trial.

assessments.decision: localized quarter-view cheek artifact to photographed color
assessments.notes: Uniform-lit geometry has no cheek pit; the unlit photo map retains it. Raycast of visible patch maps to canonical X about.566-.629 and Y-.72 to-.64, outside the prior local albedo support. This identifies the correction region without changing geometry or analyzing another image.

assessments.decision: accepted bounded outer-cheek tone correction at strength .60
assessments.notes: Compared0,.60,.90 at matched native detail and quarter views. Smoothly unioned a local ellipse centered(.588,-.700), radii(.142,.215) with the prior correction. Uses existing same-side colors from image1 with original fine residual bounded to +/-5. The dark pit recedes while soft tone remains; .90 offers no useful visual gain. Eyes, lips, nose, chin, UVs, geometry, and hidden-side field remain unchanged.

assessments.decision: accepted lower-hair flow candidate59 with the current cloth and face refinements
assessments.notes: Five native views reviewed. Rear ends now use physical drop, unequal terminal bends and fuller overlapping layers, improving the regular sawtooth hem and reducing vertical gaps. Identified short-curl and inner-front shoulder wedges are gathered; one outer-front family still protrudes and is assigned for repair. Hair triangles1104568 and buffers51.62MiB are unchanged from57. Actual browser heap251MiB; CPU submission2.2ms is not a GPU frame-time measurement. The crown still reads as a solid cap; goal remains unmet.
